# Novartis ranks #19 in TIME and Statista’s World’s Best Companies 2026


Novartis has earned a spot among the world’s top performers, ranking #19 in TIME and Statista’s World’s Best Companies 2026 – a significant rise from #114 last year. The recognition reflects progress across three critical areas: business performance, workplace experience, and sustainability.


Oct 21, 2026


## What’s behind the ranking


TIME and Statista’s annual list evaluates more than 1 000 organizations through a methodology that looks beyond financials. Companies are assessed equally across three dimensions:


- **Employee satisfaction** – based on independent global surveys and peer recommendations.
- **Revenue growth** – Measured using audited multi-year performance.
- **Sustainability transparency** – Assessed through ESG reporting standards, governance and performance.


This holistic approach creates an independent measure of organizational strength and long-term value creation.


## What it means for Novartis


Moving from #114 to #19 signals the impact of bold changes underway – strengthening business results, building a more engaging culture, and deepening our commitment to sustainability and responsible business practices.


Behind this progress are more than 70 000 Novartis associates worldwide- scientists, manufacturing teams, digital experts – working to tackle the toughest challenges in healthcare and deliver breakthroughs that redefine the future of medicine.


## Looking ahead


While rankings aren’t the destination, this recognition reinforces that we are on the right path: creating value for patients, employees, investors, and society – today and for generations to come.
